### Which @angular/* package(s) are the source of the bug? compiler, core, language-service ### Is this a regression? No ### Description with strict mode on for TypeScript ``` "compilerOptions": { "strict": true, ... ``` ``` export type AccessibleValue = | { isAccessible: true; value: T } | { isAccessible: false; value: null; }; ``` evaluates to string correctly in typescript ``` if (this.testValue.accessible?.isAccessible) { this.stringOnlyToTest = this.testValue.accessible.value; } ``` but in the template, it throws ``` Argument of type 'string | null' is not assignable to parameter of type 'string'. Type 'null' is not assignable to type 'string'. ``` ```
